note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are parsed into an HTTP message and later reused by the HTTP serving path.

code: int flags = uri_to_path(c, hm, opts, path, sizeof(path));
note: The parsed request URI is converted into a filesystem path for directory serving.
The request headers are consulted for a Range header that controls the later byte-range response logic.
The range parser must only accept a well-formed bytes= prefix before converting the rest into numeric offsets; malformed or oversized values can violate the intended bounds check.
The parsed range is used to decide whether the response is satisfiable; a bad parse can drive the response into the invalid range-handling path.
